meta.policy: Public repos only; only work with a large personal contribution. Fork / engine work is listed as 'contributions', labeled with the personal commit count. Cards link the repo, models, demo and papers where those exist.
meta.tok_s: Displayed generation rate for a card: the record types itself in at this speed when the card comes to the front. It is flavour, so set it to a real measured throughput per project, or drop the field to fall back to 60.

projects.title: Scion
projects.hook: Ternary MoE quantization with trained corrections: the harness behind the released Scion-35B-A3B and Scion-FlashNext-176B-A6B.
bullets: Ternarises the expert banks of a pretrained MoE in place, then recovers the routing damage with small trained corrections on the residual stream: no full-precision masters, no full-model QAT
The frozen body ships at ~2.125 bpw (Q1_0_g128 / PQ2_0 ternary experts, Q8_0 for the rest)
Harness, port decisions and release docs, cloned and run on their own

projects.title: Hive
projects.hook: A local-first stack for memory, verification, and routing in language models.
bullets: Splinter Memory: managed-decay context curation, with the white paper and code in the same repo
The Hive Cascade: a gold-free verification-and-repair loop, with the controller contract and measured tier table
HiveBench: the evaluation suite that measures both, with reproducible A/B runs and a public results log

projects.title: Splinter Memory
projects.hook: An external, managed-decay context-curation layer for long-horizon LLM conversations.
bullets: Context lives outside the model and decays by policy, not by truncation
The white paper, encoder notes, figures and the full code live in hive/splinter
Python / PyTorch / FastAPI with a full CI pipeline

projects.title: Bonsai 2 ternary forensics
projects.hook: Independent forensics on Bonsai 2 27B: recovering a ~2 bpw ternary model's format, basis, and quality gap.
bullets: Recovered the storage format and the rotation basis of Bonsai 2 27B (Prism ML's ternary model built from Qwen3.8-27B)
Localized the quality gap to the trained weights, and showed a widely cited public PTQ baseline is a calibration-passage artifact

projects.title: Strata: engine fork work
projects.hook: Kernel fusions and speculative decoding in the Strata inference engine (fork of Niko1221/Strata).
bullets: Fused kernels with measured per-change wins on the 35B (router tail 8.84→8.69; shared-expert down kernel 8.64→8.54)
The k=1 MTP drafter (--mtp-sidecar) plus the probes the drafter trains from
31 commits in a ~2,200-commit engine

projects.title: PixelQR
projects.hook: Pixel art that becomes a real, scannable QR code.
bullets: Writable canvas: zero random code cells inside the drawing area, re-verified with a real decoder after every edit
Payload-freedom solver: free exact cell fixes (GF(2)) from the bytes decoders never read
Six decode-verified render styles; styled PNG / SVG / 1024px avatar exports
No build step, no CDN: only the vendored encoder and decoder

projects.title: ScrollPeak
projects.hook: A scrollbar minimap for Firefox: hover the scrollbar to see the whole page as a small map, click to jump.
bullets: The map is the page's own rendering, scaled down; falls back to a text raster when the page can't be cloned
A port of the minimap from KDE's Kate editor

projects.title: DeepSeek Harness: plugin work
projects.hook: Plugins and tooling for the DeepSeek Harness (fork of deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
bullets: context-strata plugin: session context wired into the agent loop
Studio wizard and host integration; verify gates for model launches
80 commits in the fork

projects.title: Prism: llama.cpp engine work
projects.hook: MoE expert-residency experiments in a llama.cpp fork.
bullets: FreeToken-style MoE expert slot cache (decode), with identity promotion for fully-covered caches
Kernel fusion experiments with a measurement rig; notes archived in-repo
19 commits in the fork
